# Risk Monitoring and Regulatory Compliance Guidelines

This document emphasizes key areas for risk management and compliance within the bank.

*   Monitor internal control based on audit findings.
*   Review and update based on regulatory changes standards.
*   Urgently review all regulatory changes.
*   Monitor internal control standards.
*   Monitor legal risks for the 2026 strategy.
